title: Lodging Defects via Novade App
content: Defects must be documented with photos and lodged item-by-item through the developer's Novade application. Many third-party defect inspection services can log these directly into the app on your behalf after conducting their walkthrough.

title: Joint Inspection Scheduling Process
content: Once all defects are submitted on the Novade app, contact the Lentor Modern customer service representative who assisted you during key collection to arrange a joint inspection date with the customer service and main contractor teams.

title: Contractor Access During Rectification
content: Homeowners do not need to be physically present during ongoing defect rectifications. The developer's contractors will access the unit across multiple days to carry out repairs, which typically take up to 30 days depending on the volume of work required, before a final joint walkthrough.

title: Utilities Grace Period for Inspection
content: Lentor Modern provides a complimentary 7-day grace period of water and electricity after key handover, allowing sufficient utility supply to test electrical points, appliances, and plumbing during initial defect inspections before setting up an SP Services account.

title: Defect Rectification and Move-In Timelines
content: When planning handover and lease transitions, factor in approximately 1 month for comprehensive defect checking and contractor rectifications, followed by 4 to 6 weeks for interior renovation works before moving in.

title: Critical Areas to Inspect Beyond Cosmetics
content: Ensure defect checks go beyond cosmetic paint and surface blemishes to include technical testing of bedroom data/network points, hollow floor or wall tiles, and proper water drainage/ponding gradients in common and master bathrooms.

title: Developer-Provided Kitchen and Laundry Appliances
content: Units come equipped with core major appliances provided by the developer, which include the refrigerator, oven, and washer/dryer.

title: Light Switch Wiring for Smart Home Integration
content: No neutral wire is provided at the wall lighting switches. Residents planning to convert to smart switches must ensure they purchase no-neutral switch models or install bypass capacitors/relays compatible with their setup.

title: Smart Home Hub and Motorised Blinds Integration
content: The developer provides a central smart home hub for unit controls. This hub can be linked to mobile applications for home access and integrated with supported motorized outdoor blinds (such as Dooya-compatible systems).

title: Dishwasher Space and Tabletop Solutions
content: Built-in dishwasher cabinetry and dedicated plumbing may be limited depending on the unit layout. Residents looking to add dishwashing capabilities should measure countertop dimensions and consider compact tabletop dishwashers.

title: Window Solar Film to Reduce Aircon Cooling Load
content: For units receiving afternoon sun exposure, installing UV and heat-blocking solar film on windows helps mitigate indoor heat accumulation and reduces the daily operating load on air conditioning units.

title: Delivery and Visitor Access Routing (Level 2)
content: The Level 1 intercom is intentionally disabled by management to prevent congestion and protect the lobby. All visitors and delivery riders must drive up to the Level 2 carpark to access the tower intercom. Residents should add delivery notes instructing riders to head to Level 2. Note that vehicles over 3 meters tall cannot access Level 2, meaning residents may need to meet these drivers at Level 1.

title: Granting Lift Access via iPlus Living App
content: To allow delivery riders to reach your doorstep, they must key in your unit number at the gate or lift lobby entrance. You can then grant them access using the iPlus Living app, which enables them to select your floor in the lift. If riders tail-gate others into the lift lobby without being buzzed in, they will not have the authorization to press your floor button.

title: Lift Access Card Tapping Workaround
content: If your floor button fails to register or turns off after tapping your access card, introduce a brief pause. Wait 1 to 2 seconds after tapping your card before pressing the floor button to allow the lift system enough time to register the card's authorization.

title: Permitted House Moving and Bulky Delivery Hours
content: House moving and bulky deliveries are restricted to specific timeframes under Form 2.1 (Application for House Moving and Bulky Delivery). Permitted hours are Mondays to Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., and Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.

title: Canceling Wrong Lift Floor Selections
content: If you or a visitor accidentally presses the wrong floor button inside the lift, you can cancel the selection by pressing the same button twice.

title: Balcony Zip Blinds Approval and Guidelines
content: Installation of zip track blinds at the balcony is permitted, subject to the guidelines in the resident handbook. Homeowners can request the handbook and the list of approved colors from the Managing Agent (MA) on or after the day of key collection.

title: Balcony Invisible Grille Installation
content: Residents are permitted to install invisible grilles at the balcony. These are commonly installed alongside zip blinds for safety and weather protection.

title: Balcony Structure Variations for Blinds
content: When getting quotes for balcony zip blinds, note that some units feature a half-height wall on one side of the balcony. This means the blind panels will not be of uniform height, as one side will require a shorter panel.

title: Function Room Amenities
content: The condominium's function room is equipped with a pool (billiard) table available for resident use.

title: Mall Opening Timeline and Childcare Provider Status
content: According to developer updates, Lentor Modern Mall is scheduled to open to the public in early 2026. The developer is currently in discussions with various childcare providers to finalize the preschool operator.

title: Visitor Pedestrian Access from MRT and Taxi Stand
content: Visitors arriving via MRT or taxi must enter through the concierge entrance near Burger King. Otherwise, residents must physically go down to escort visitors up, as direct access from other points is restricted.

title: Vehicle Entrance and Slip Road Layout
content: The development features a single-lane 'IN' slip road for both residents and the public. This lane subsequently splits, with the left lane leading to the residential area and the right lane leading to the mall carpark.

title: Confirmed Retailers and Tenant Directory
content: Confirmed tenants include CS Fresh (supermarket currently undergoing renovation) and Pinnacle Clinic. Residents can check the official Lentor Modern website under 'Opening Soon: F&B and Essentials' for the latest list of incoming shops.

title: Burner Bin Location
content: A burner bin is located outside the mall near the entrance of the carpark, situated along the grass patch.

title: SMEG Induction Hob 'L' Code Unlock
content: When code 'L' appears on your SMEG induction hob display, the Child Controls Lock is engaged. With at least one zone powered, press and hold the Key Symbol button for 1-2 seconds until the LED turns off.

title: Fiber Broadband Riser Key for Internet Setup
content: For Singtel, Starhub, or Simba fiber broadband activation, telecom technicians need access to the floor's fiber riser closet. Request the riser key from the 24/7 Security Guardhouse 15 minutes before your technician arrives.

title: Residential Loading Bay & Bulky Deliveries
content: Delivery trucks for Taobao, furniture, or appliances should enter via the residential car park ramp on Lentor Central (height limit 3.8m). Inform security at the barrier that it is a residential delivery.

title: Novade App Defect Reporting Workflow
content: When logging defects in Novade, take one wide photo showing the whole wall/floor and one close-up macro photo with blue masking tape marking the spot. This avoids contractors rejecting tickets for 'location unclear'.

title: Balcony Ziprak & External Blind Restrictions
content: Exterior balcony blinds must comply with GuocoLand / MCST uniform colour and material by-laws (dark grey / charcoal perforated zip blinds). Unapproved colours will fail inspection and forfeit renovation deposit.

title: CS Fresh Evening Grocery Discounts
content: CS Fresh supermarket at B1 of Lentor Modern Mall regularly discounts sushi, ready-to-eat bento boxes, and fresh bakery items by 20% to 30% daily starting from 8:30 PM.

title: Yale Digital Lock Emergency 9V Jumpstart
content: If your Yale main door lock batteries are completely flat, touch a standard rectangular 9V battery against the two external contact pins below the lock keypad to power the lock temporarily and enter your PIN.

title: Aircon SWG Copper Piping Specifications
content: When engaging third-party aircon servicing or relocation, ensure contractors strictly adhere to GuocoLand's specification of SWG 22 (0.71mm thickness) copper piping to maintain building warranty.

title: Official Unit Paint Codes (Internal Walls & Balcony)
content:
Verified developer paint specifications for Lentor Modern:
• Internal Walls & Ceilings: Intermatt BS E55 (White).
• Balcony & External Façade: Dulux (ICI) 'Thick Smoke' — Colour Code: 96YR 09/033 (Composilicon W55).
Provide these exact codes to your painter/ID for touch-ups to avoid patchy walls and ensure compliance with MCST façade appearance by-laws.
